zh.STORE_TAGLINE: 病人不交全症状。望、闻、问、切，都要你亲手做。
zh.STORE_NOT_MEDICAL: 文化体验，不能替代就医。
zh.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_BODY: 本作是中医文化体验游戏，不是医疗建议，也不能替代执业医师的诊断或治疗。如有身体不适，请及时就医。
zh.HINT_LOOK: 看神色、舌象、形态。病人不会自己报全。
zh.HINT_ASK: 问，但别把诊断名问出来。
zh.HINT_PULSE: 把脉。浮沉迟数、虚实会直接告诉你。
zh.TENQ_HINT: 催你还没做的诊，不是百科。
zh.TENQ_01_ASK: 怕冷还是怕热？发热多久？恶风吗？
zh.TENQ_02_ASK: 有汗无汗？汗出在何时、何部位？
zh.TENQ_03_ASK: 头何处痛？身重还是身痛？腰腿如何？
zh.TENQ_04_ASK: 大便干稀次数？小便色次？
zh.TENQ_05_ASK: 能吃吗？口淡油腻？饭后胀不胀？
zh.TENQ_08_ASK: 口渴吗？想不想饮？喜热喜冷？
zh.TENQ_09_ASK: 以前得过什么？一直吃什么方？
zh.TENQ_10_ASK: 从什么时候、因什么起的？
zh.TENQ_EXTRA_MENS_ASK: 周期准不准？身上困重绵绵？
zh.TENQ_EXTRA_CHILD_ASK: 问乳食、问睡、问是否受惊，问大人核实。

zh.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BEIMU: 贝母与乌头相反，同用会相攻。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BAILIAN: 白蔹与乌头相反，禁止同方。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BAIJI: 白及与乌头相反，不能同盏。

zh.FANWEI_SHORT_GANCAO_YUANHUA: 甘草与芫花相反，同盏会相战。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_SHEN: 藜芦与参类相反，补药加涌吐会相叛。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_ZHUSHEN: 藜芦与诸参皆反，这一味参也算。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_XIXIN: 细辛与藜芦相反，不能同用。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_SHAOYAO: 芍药与藜芦相反，禁止同盏。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LIUHUANG_MANGXIAO: 硫黄遇朴硝，教材列为十九畏。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_SHUIYIN_PISHUANG: 二味剧毒相畏，游戏不准同见。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_LANGDU_MITUOSENG: 狼毒畏密陀僧，不能同方。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_BADUO_QIANNIU: 巴豆与牵牛不顺，泻下叠泻下会相畏。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_DINGXIANG_YUJIN: 丁香畏郁金，一温一凉会相掣。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_MANGXIAO_SANLENG: 牙硝难合三棱，破积又润下会相畏。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_JIAO: 乌头畏角类，热毒与寒清相掣。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_RENSHEN_WULINGZHI: 人参最怕五灵脂，补气与破瘀相畏。
zh.FANWEI_SHORT_ROUGUI_CHISHIZHI: 官桂遇石脂便相欺，温通与涩收相畏。
zh.MENTOR_MISS_LOOK: 人还没进门，你倒先开柜了。
zh.MENTOR_MISS_LISTEN: 他进门那口气，你听了吗。
zh.MENTOR_MISS_QI: 眼里看见的，嘴里问过没有？
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_COLD: 他添衣还是减衣，你问了？
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_SWEAT: 出汗了没有——这一句能挡掉一半胡开。
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_FOOD: 不想吃，和吃了就胀，是两件事。
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_CHEST: 手按胸口的人，不一定是心。你问过胁下没有。
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_THIRST: 渴不渴，想不想喝，喝热还是喝冷——三个字别并成一个。
zh.MENTOR_TENQ_MENS: 若要问周期，先屏退左右。
zh.MENTOR_FANWEI: 半夏和附子，歌诀里是反，不是口味不合。
zh.MENTOR_SU_MISS_WANG: 先看他眼睛愿不愿看你。
zh.MENTOR_SU_MISS_WEN: 他进门那口气，你听了吗。
zh.MENTOR_SU_MISS_ASK: 寒热和汗——这两扇，你走过了吗？
zh.MENTOR_BUBBLE_HINT: 同诊最多两句。不报方，不报证。
zh.XIAOHE_WAIT_3: 阿福大哥站不住，先让他？
zh.XIAOHE_CABINET_2: 甘草又少了……不是我偷的！大概。
zh.XIAOHE_FANWEI_ALERT: 这味进不了盏！歌诀里写过的。
zh.FOLLOWUP_FENGHAN_BIAO: 阿福说肩背松些了。江风再灌，让他早点回来。
zh.FOLLOWUP_GANYU_QIZHI: 清荷夜里少翻几次。胁下还闷，记着让她再来坐坐。
zh.FOLLOWUP_YINXU_NEIRE: 周婆婆手足心还热不热，过两日问问。别让她只喝邻人的旧方。
zh.SCORE_M_HINT: 对证程度。不是有没有点中唯一答案。
zh.FORAGE_DONE_HINT: 采好的药，回药房就能入托盘。

zh.AGUI_HINT_3: 根朝下码齐，鲜的才不烂。

zh.HERB_SHENGJIANG_CLUE_2: 冲鼻的辛辣，搓手还留味。

zh.HERB_GANCAO_CLUE_3: 性印象：平，能把方里各味拢住。
zh.HERB_CHAIHU_CLUE_3: 性印象：微寒，爱往胁上走。

zh.HERB_BAIZHU_CLUE_3: 性印象：温，偏脾胃那一路。

en.STORE_TAGLINE: The patient never hands you a complete chart. Look, listen, ask, then feel the pulse.
en.STORE_NOT_MEDICAL: A cultural game. Not medical advice.
en.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_BODY: This is a cultural game, not a medical product. It cannot diagnose, treat, or replace a licensed practitioner. If you feel unwell, seek real care.
en.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER: Not a substitute for medical care
en.HINT_LOOK: Watch face, tongue, bearing. They will not volunteer the full chart.
en.HINT_LISTEN: Hear the breath. Catch the scent.
en.HINT_ASK: Ask. Do not fish for a diagnosis name.
en.HINT_PULSE: Feel the pulse. Depth, rate, and strength are readable, not riddles.
en.SCORE_INCOMPLETE_EXAM: The four exams are incomplete. Score is reduced.
en.TENQ_HINT: Nudge what you skipped. Not an encyclopedia.
en.TENQ_01_ASK: Chills or heat? How long feverish? Afraid of wind?
en.TENQ_02_ASK: Any sweat? When, and where on the body?
en.TENQ_03_ASK: Where does the head hurt? Heavy or aching body? How are the back and legs?
en.TENQ_04_ASK: Stool: dry or loose, how often? Urine: color and frequency?
en.TENQ_05_ASK: Appetite? Bland or greasy mouth? Bloating after meals?
en.TENQ_06_ASK: Chest or flank fullness or pain? Palpitation, wheeze, cough?
en.TENQ_07_ASK: Ringing or hearing loss? Blurry or red eyes?
en.TENQ_08_ASK: Thirsty? Want to drink? Prefer hot or cold?
en.TENQ_09_ASK: Any old illness? Still taking a formula?
en.TENQ_10_ASK: When did it start, and after what?
en.TENQ_EXTRA_MENS_ASK: Is the cycle regular? Heavy, dragging fatigue?
en.TENQ_EXTRA_CHILD_ASK: Ask milk and food, sleep, fright; confirm with the adult.
en.FANWEI_BOUNCED: That herb will not enter the bowl.
en.FANWEI_GENERIC: These two are listed as incompatible and cannot share a bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BANXIA: Aconite and pinellia are listed as incompatible; they clash in one bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_GUALOU: Trichosanthes and aconite are incompatible; not in the same bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BEIMU: Fritillaria and aconite are incompatible; they clash together.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BAILIAN: Ampelopsis and aconite are incompatible; not in one formula.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_BAIJI: Bletilla and aconite are incompatible; not in the same bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_GANCAO_HAIZAO: Licorice and seaweed are incompatible; they fight each other.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_GANCAO_DAJI: Licorice and Peking spurge are incompatible; not in one formula.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_GANCAO_GANSUI: Licorice and kansui are incompatible; not in the same bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_GANCAO_YUANHUA: Licorice and genkwa are incompatible; they fight in one bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_SHEN: Veratrum clashes with ginseng-class tonics; tonify plus emetic rebels.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_ZHUSHEN: Veratrum clashes with all listed shen herbs, including this one.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_XIXIN: Asarum and veratrum are incompatible; do not combine.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LILU_SHAOYAO: Peony and veratrum are incompatible; not in the same bowl.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LIUHUANG_MANGXIAO: Sulfur meets mirabilite: listed among the nineteen cautions.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_SHUIYIN_PISHUANG: Both are highly toxic and mutually cautioned; never shown together.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_LANGDU_MITUOSENG: Langdu cautions against litharge; not in one formula.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_BADUO_QIANNIU: Croton and morning glory both purge hard; they caution each other.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_DINGXIANG_YUJIN: Clove cautions against turmeric root; warm and cool check each other.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_MANGXIAO_SANLENG: Mirabilite and sparganium caution each other: purge plus break stasis.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_WU_JIAO: Aconite cautions against horn-class coolants; heat-toxin meets cold-clear.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_RENSHEN_WULINGZHI: Ginseng most fears flying squirrel dung: tonify meets break-stasis.
en.FANWEI_SHORT_ROUGUI_CHISHIZHI: Cinnamon meets halloysite: warm-open and astringent caution each other.
en.MENTOR_TEA: Ask what you need. Then I drink tea.
en.MENTOR_MISS_LOOK: They are not even seated, and you already opened the cabinet.
en.MENTOR_MISS_TONGUE: Has the mouth been opened yet?
en.MENTOR_MISS_LISTEN: Did you hear the breath they came in with?
en.MENTOR_MISS_PULSE: The pulse pillow is still empty.
en.MENTOR_MISS_ASK_SHORT: Nine of the ten questions are still on the table.
en.MENTOR_MISS_QI: What your eyes saw—did your mouth ask it?
en.MENTOR_TENQ_COLD: Did you ask whether they add layers or shed them?
en.MENTOR_TENQ_SWEAT: Any sweat? That one question blocks half the wild prescriptions.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_HEAD: Pain at the brow, the crown, or the nape?
en.MENTOR_TENQ_STOOL: Without stool and urine asked, do not commit a formula.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_FOOD: No appetite and bloating after eating are two different things.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_CHEST: A hand on the chest is not always the heart. Ask under the ribs.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_THIRST: Thirst, desire to drink, hot or cold—do not mash three into one.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_HISTORY: Are they still taking the old formula?
en.MENTOR_TENQ_MENS: If you ask about the cycle, clear the room first.
en.MENTOR_TENQ_CHILD: Ask the child, and ask the one who carries them.
en.MENTOR_FANWEI: Pinellia and aconite are listed as incompatible—not a matter of taste.
en.FANWEI_LOCKED: Cannot share the tray — incompatibility lock.
en.FANWEI_LOCKED_FAN: Eighteen incompatibilities — cannot share the tray.
en.FANWEI_LOCKED_WEI: Nineteen antagonisms — cannot share the tray.
en.MENTOR_SU_MISS_WANG: See whether their eyes will meet yours.
en.MENTOR_SU_MISS_WEN: Did you hear the breath they came in on?
en.MENTOR_SU_MISS_QIE: The pulse pillow is still empty.
en.MENTOR_SU_MISS_ASK: Cold/heat and sweat — did you pass those two doors?
en.MENTOR_BUBBLE_HINT: At most two lines per visit. No formula. No pattern name.
en.XIAOHE_WAIT_2: Someone's still tapping at the door.
en.XIAOHE_WAIT_3: Brother Afu can't stand still — let him first?
en.XIAOHE_CABINET_2: Licorice's low again… not me! Probably.
en.XIAOHE_CABINET_3: Fresh roots point down — A'gui said so.
en.XIAOHE_IDLE_2: Wet cuffs are fine — that's the plot.
en.XIAOHE_FANWEI_ALERT: That herb won't enter the bowl! The rhyme says so.
en.FOLLOWUP_HINT: Look in again in a few days.
en.FOLLOWUP_FENGHAN_BIAO: Afu says the shoulders eased. If the river wind returns, have him come early.
en.FOLLOWUP_GANYU_QIZHI: Qinghe turns less at night. If the flank still feels full, have her sit again.
en.FOLLOWUP_YINXU_NEIRE: In two days, ask if Granny Zhou's palms and soles still run hot. Don't let her keep only a neighbor's old brew.
en.SCORE_M_HINT: How well the treatment fits. Not a single correct answer.
en.FORAGE_PATH_HINT: A short path outside holds a few more.
en.FORAGE_WRONG: Not that. Look again at form, color, scent.
en.FORAGE_UNKNOWN_TRAY: Unidentified herbs cannot enter the tray.
en.FORAGE_DONE_HINT: Picked herbs can go on the tray back in the pharmacy.
en.AGUI_HINT_1: The ones with pale powder under the leaves — don't mix them with the neighbors.
en.AGUI_HINT_2: Smell it. Beats staring at a name.
en.AGUI_HINT_3: Roots down, lined up — fresh ones keep.
en.MENTOR_FORAGE: Know the herb before you touch a patient.

ja.GAME_SUBTITLE: 望聞問切は、あなたがやる。
ja.STORE_TAGLINE: 患者は症状をすべて話さない。望・聞・問・切は、あなたがやる動詞だ。
ja.STORE_NOT_MEDICAL: 文化体験ゲームです。医療アドバイスではありません。
ja.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_TITLE: 医療アドバイスではありません
ja.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_BODY: 本作は文化体験ゲームであり、医療アドバイスではありません。医師の診断・治療の代わりにはなりません。体調がすぐれない場合は、医療機関を受診してください。
ja.BOOT_DISCLAIMER_FOOTER: 受診の代わりにはなりません
ja.HINT_LOOK: 顔色・舌・姿を見る。患者は全部を話さない。
ja.HINT_LISTEN: 声息を聞き、匂いを読む。
ja.HINT_ASK: 問う。病名を聞き出そうとしない。
ja.HINT_PULSE: 脈を取る。浮沈・遅数・虚実は読める手がかりであり、謎かけではない。
ja.SCORE_INCOMPLETE_EXAM: 四診が揃っていないため、評価は下がる。
ja.SAVE_OVERWRITE: このスロットを上書きしますか？
ja.TENQ_HINT: まだやっていない診を促す。百科ではない。
ja.TENQ_01_ASK: 寒がりか、熱っぽいか。熱はどのくらい。風を嫌がるか。
ja.TENQ_02_ASK: 汗はあるか。いつ、どこに出るか。
ja.TENQ_03_ASK: 頭のどこが痛む。体が重いか痛いか。腰脚はどうか。
ja.TENQ_04_ASK: 大便の硬さ・回数は。小便の色と回数は。
ja.TENQ_05_ASK: 食欲はあるか。口が淡いか油っこいか。食後に張るか。
ja.TENQ_06_ASK: 胸脇が張って痛むか。動悸・喘・咳は。
ja.TENQ_07_ASK: 耳鳴りや聞こえにくさは。目のかすみや充血は。
